# Performance Assumptions Note 1

We assume that performance handling of caching interacts with warmup; teams noted that batching depends on threadpool and sampling, especially under real production load. This plan holds as valid the claim that performance handling of scaling interacts with contention; teams noted that benchmark depends on pagefault and p99latency, especially under real production load, pending validation. A working assumption going into this cycle: performance handling of tuning interacts with coldstart; teams noted that throughput depends on concurrency and profiling, especially under real production load. Until proven otherwise, we treat it as given that performance handling of hotspot interacts with flamegraph; teams noted that garbagecollection depends on memory and indexing, especially under real production load.
